gaps.quote: The outer two cost linear time.
gaps.note: Linear in what is not said: the field width u, the volume V, or the total bit count. The page never justifies the cost of the two outer updates, and the claimed total O(V u^tau) depends on which measure is meant.

gaps.note: The page never says that these three updates are the forward, inverse, forward schedule it cites, or how the outer updates are invocations of that kind. The role of the cited result here is not stated, so the reader cannot check that the schedule accounts for this exchange.
Nothing on the page gives mu < 2^20. mu is defined only as a vertex's row count, and no network size is stated, so this bound on ln mu rests on an unstated fact.

The chain does not follow as written. From ln mu < 20, exp(-2^-50 ln mu) is greater than 1 - 20*2^-50, not less, so the inequality sign is reversed. The needed fact, exp(...) > 1 - 20*2^-50 > 1 - eta, is not stated, so lambda < mu^tau is not established.
